{
  "dataset_name": "airlines",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "time_of_day_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Departure time normalized to [0,1] range across the full day (0-1439 minutes), providing a smooth continuous representation of time position in the day",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear SVM can use this smooth continuous feature to find optimal time-based decision boundaries for delay prediction",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "Time / 1439.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "late_day_departure_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Score emphasizing afternoon and evening departures (after 720 minutes / noon) which tend to accumulate delays throughout the day",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the known pattern that later flights accumulate delays; smooth score useful for linear margin separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((Time - 720.0) / 719.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "flight_length_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Flight duration normalized by log transformation and scaled to [0,1] using training set min/max (log1p(25)=3.258, log1p(560)=6.330)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "flight_characteristics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized flight length reduces skewness and provides smooth input for linear SVM margin optimization",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(Length) - np.log1p(25.0)) / (np.log1p(560.0) - np.log1p(25.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "time_length_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction between normalized departure time and normalized flight length, capturing combined effect of late departures on long flights",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an approximate bilinear feature that linear SVM can use to capture interaction effects between time and flight duration",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(Time / 1439.0) * ((np.log1p(Length) - np.log1p(25.0)) / (np.log1p(560.0) - np.log1p(25.0)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "peak_hour_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Soft indicator for peak travel hours (6am-9am: 360-540 min, and 4pm-8pm: 960-1200 min) using smooth transitions",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures congestion during peak hours which correlates with delays; smooth score better than hard binary for SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(np.clip((Time - 360.0) / 90.0, 0.0, 1.0) * np.clip((540.0 - Time) / 90.0, 0.0, 1.0), np.clip((Time - 960.0) / 120.0, 0.0, 1.0) * np.clip((1200.0 - Time) / 120.0, 0.0, 1.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "weekend_flight_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator for weekend flights (Saturday=6, Sunday=7) which have different delay patterns than weekdays",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Weekend vs weekday distinction provides a useful binary feature for linear SVM to separate delay patterns",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((DayOfWeek == '6') | (DayOfWeek == '7'), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "midweek_congestion_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Score for midweek days (Wednesday=3, Thursday=4, Friday=5) which are typically busiest travel days with higher delay risk",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Midweek congestion pattern provides discriminative signal for linear SVM delay prediction",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((DayOfWeek == '3') | (DayOfWeek == '4') | (DayOfWeek == '5'), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "long_haul_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Soft indicator for long-haul flights (above mean length of 131 minutes), normalized by standard deviation (70 minutes)",
      "value_range": [-1.52, 6.13],
      "feature_family": "flight_characteristics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardized flight length deviation from mean provides a centered feature useful for SVM margin optimization",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(Length - 131.26) / 69.96"
    },
    {
      "name": "time_deviation_from_mean",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized departure time deviation from training mean (803.26 minutes) scaled by standard deviation (277.21 minutes)",
      "value_range": [-2.85, 2.29],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Zero-centered time feature improves SVM convergence and allows linear separation around the mean departure time",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(Time - 803.26) / 277.21"
    },
    {
      "name": "airline_delay_propensity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of airline's historical delay propensity based on carrier reputation and operational characteristics. WN (Southwest) and regional carriers (OO, MQ, XE, EV) scored higher due to known operational challenges; major network carriers (DL, AA, UA) scored moderate; low-cost efficient carriers scored lower.",
      "value_range": [0.1, 0.9],
      "feature_family": "carrier_characteristics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes domain knowledge about carrier reliability into a continuous score that linear SVM can use as a weighted feature",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "hub_airport_congestion_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of departure airport congestion level based on hub status and known congestion. Major hubs (ATL, ORD, DFW, LAX, JFK) scored high (0.7-0.9); secondary hubs (DEN, IAH, PHX, DTW) scored medium (0.4-0.6); smaller airports scored low (0.1-0.3).",
      "value_range": [0.1, 0.9],
      "feature_family": "airport_characteristics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Airport congestion is a key delay driver; this continuous score provides smooth signal for linear SVM boundary optimization",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "route_complexity_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of route operational complexity combining origin-destination pair characteristics. Cross-country routes, routes through weather-prone regions, and routes between major congested hubs scored higher (0.6-0.9); short regional hops scored lower (0.1-0.4).",
      "value_range": [0.1, 0.9],
      "feature_family": "route_characteristics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Route complexity captures geographic and operational factors affecting delays that complement time-based features for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
